name: Load the PowOS launchd agents at boot (Mac LaunchDaemon)
purpose: at boot and every 10 min (LaunchDaemon com.powos.mac-agents-boot, tools/agents/mac-agents-boot.sh, as root): `launchctl bootstrap user/<uid>` for each ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.powos.*.plist that is installed but not loaded. The Mac is headless, so after a reboot launchd loads no LaunchAgents: the 11-02 and 11-07 reboots silently stopped board-sweep (worktree gc) and mac-disk-trim (Colima fstrim) and the disk ran to 0 GB. Never edits, unloads or restarts a loaded agent; a removed agent (plist deleted) stays removed
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one short bash pass (a launchctl print per agent, a bootstrap only for a missing one) every 10 minutes
